events.body: Had a charge notice by email today for 63.60 for my loom parts, IC-5316. Is this real? I've had scam customs texts before and I'm not clicking a payment link until I know. Can you find out and send me the breakdown here. No rush, I'm away next week anyway.

The recipient of DL-6126, Juno Thackery, asks whether charge notice IC-5316 for GBP 63.60 is genuine and what it is made up of. Please confirm whether the notice is yours, the breakdown, how he can pay without using the emailed link, and how long the parcel is held.

IC-5316 is ours and is correct. DL-6126: duty GBP 18.40, import VAT GBP 37.20, handling fee GBP 8.00, total GBP 63.60. He does not have to use the emailed link; the same charge shows under Charges when he signs in to the Customer portal. The parcel is held at Destination depot until 2028-05-26. If unpaid by then it returns to the shipper.

Import billing at Marrowby Arc confirm that charge notice IC-5316 is theirs. Their breakdown for DL-6126 is duty GBP 18.40, import VAT GBP 37.20 and a handling fee of GBP 8.00, total GBP 63.60. You don't need the emailed link: the same charge is listed under Charges when you sign in to this portal. They are holding the parcel at the depot until 2028-05-26, and if the charge is unpaid by then it goes back to the shipper.

Automatic reply: Thanks for your message. I am away from Saturday 6 May and back on Monday 15 May with no access to email or messages. I will read everything when I am back. Juno

I have spoken to a solicitor and I will be issuing a small claims court claim against you unless I hear back today.
